extDescription.message: A browser extension toolbox for Bahamut Anime Crazy (ani.gamer.com.tw)

popupSubtitle.message: Toggle each feature on or off

opt3xDesc.message: Add 3x to the top of the playback speed menu

optVolumeStep5Title.description: Toggle: snap arrow-key volume to 5% steps

optVolumeStep5Desc.message: Move to the next 5% volume step with each default ↑/↓ shortcut press
optVolumeStep5Desc.description: Toggle help: snap arrow-key volume to 5% steps

optMarkerDesc.message: Show a yellow “current time + 90s” marker; press S to skip 90 seconds

optMarkerDescDefault.message: Show a yellow “current time + 90s” marker; press S or $1 to skip 90 seconds
optMarkerDescDefault.description: Toggle help: +90s marker with the default shortcut

optMarkerDescCustom.message: Show a yellow “current time + 90s” marker; press $1 to skip 90 seconds (S is disabled)
optMarkerDescCustom.description: Toggle help: +90s marker with a custom shortcut

optCommentTimecodeDesc.message: Jump to the player and start playback at the selected comment timestamp
optCommentTimecodeDesc.description: Toggle help: play from comment timestamps

optCoverDesc.message: Replace the all-black pre-play screen with the cover image

optTheaterDesc.message: Show the top bar again after pause, stop, or end of playback

optAdblockDesc.message: Auto-close or hide the site’s ad-block related prompts

popupShortcutLink.description: Popup footer button: open the browser shortcut settings page
